title: AI-Powered Chatbot for Disaster Response
summary: The Ethiopian Red Cross and the Ethiopian Meteorological Institute are partners in a proposed AI chatbot that would give multilingual disaster guidance; pilots are planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The ITU entry, current as of June 2025, names the Ethiopian Red Cross and the Ethiopian Meteorological Institute as partners, with Thomas Birhanu Aklilu as contact. The chatbot is intended to provide emergency guidance, local-language information, and referrals to assistance. The entry lists future work on language support, datasets, and pilots. No source documents a completed emergency response or a benefit to any person. By October 2026 neither the Red Cross website nor the 2026 ITU interim report described a pilot or any use of the chatbot.
purpose: Make disaster guidance and assistance information easier to access.

ratings.reason: The chatbot has only a planned humanitarian pilot, and no source documents an improved emergency response.
No source reports that any resident received effective emergency help from the chatbot.
Better preparedness and smaller disaster impacts remain prospective.
